name: Tabs
summary: Switch between related panels on the same page. Two styles: Underline and Pill.
use: Content of the same level that the user does not need to see at the same time.
avoid: Steps in a process: use Stepper.
Filters on the same content: use Button group.
Navigation to other pages: use links.
anatomy: Tab: optional icon, label, optional count.
figmaProps: Tab: Label / Icon leading / Leading icon / Show count / Count
behaviour: Arrow left/right switches the tab and makes it active straight away. Home and End go to the first and last tab.
a11y: role="tablist", "tab" and "tabpanel" with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Only the active tab is in the tab order.
content: One or two words per tab.
do: Keep the order fixed. The first tab is the one people use most.
dont: Mix Underline and Pill on one page.
